items.ref: map doc contradiction note (D1 vs D6), confirmed still open
items.archaeology: ARCHAEOLOGY: INTRODUCED_BY 939c5ca8 'fix: add process lifecycle guard ... WAL checkpoint on DB close to prevent SQLite lock contention' (cited by ISSUE-OUTCOMES-r2 for #1140, same lineage as #1143's TTL rule). ORIGINAL_INTENT: a session DB must not be reaped just because it is old if the process is still alive (PID-liveness + 14-day age, not pure age-since-creation). #1143 is the same class of bug: TTL cleanup must key off last activity, not start time. D1 says 1.x gets security-fix-only merges, but #1143 is a crash/data-loss bug, not a security fix, so merging it into 1.x conflicts with D1 as written.
regressions: If tests/session/cleanup-preserves-active-sessions.test.ts is not in the v2 KEEP-PASS list, the last-activity-vs-start-time regression is undetected.
items.question: Either widen D1 to allow crash/data-loss merges into 1.x, or explicitly say #1143/#1160/#1176/#1177/#1207/#1138/#1180/#1154 (the merge-now candidates map-P1.md lists) stay unmerged in 1.x and only land in v2.

items.ref: ADR-0008 r3 item 2 (per-pipeline decision on whether body reaches stdout) + DECISIONS-r3 Q4/Q5 (hard deny stays, v1 scope in full)
items.archaeology: ARCHAEOLOGY: INTRODUCED_BY 2731ca25 'feat: allow curl/wget with silent file-output, block stdout floods (#166)' (2026-03-22). ORIGINAL_INTENT (commit subject): let curl/wget run when output is written silently to a file, but still block the command when it would flood stdout. #1128's PR title is 'curl/wget pipe + multiline bounds' — same feature family as #166, refining the stdout-flood boundary (pipes, multi-line commands). r2 closed this citing D10 ('hard denies go away, hints only'), which is the OLD routing model. DECISIONS-r3 Q4/Q5 explicitly keep v1-scope hard denies with ADR-0008 r3 fixes, including the #166 silent/verbose curl checks and the sudo/env/xargs/command-substitution unwrap logic (routing.mjs). REGRESSION_RISK: if the doc is updated using r2's D10-based closure, the #166 stdout-flood guard and #1128's bounds refinement could be dropped from v2, which would re-break the original #166 fix by letting curl/wget pipe floods back into context unguarded.
regressions: v2 implementing only 'hints, no hard deny' per the old D10 text would re-open the #166 stdout-flood hole that #1128 was refining.
items.recommendation: Re-close as closed-by-design under ADR-0008 r3 (hard deny + v1 scope), not the old D10 citation. Carry #1128's pipe/multiline bound refinement into the GP3 golden case for curl/wget.
